mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which typically leads to stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising (measured by 1-month change > 0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%) indicate a strong economy with rising inflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% for three consecutive months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as higher interest rates compress equity valuations and slow economic growth over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, or the average return in tightening cycles is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer demand for residential construction, which typically boosts related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising (measured by 1-month change > 0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST > 850) and industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signal robust demand across multiple sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth is accelerated.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In supply shock regimes (INDPRO falling below 100 for three consecutive months), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 60 trading days as manufacturing disruptions reduce corporate profitability and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as supply shocks, or the average return in supply shock periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
